title: Bonus Episode: Why is COVID-19 Disproportionately Affecting Black and Latino Americans with Brian Smedley, PhD

sentences.en: Although we don't have a complete national picture, data from a few states and cities
sentences.zh: 虽然我们还没有全国范围的完整数据，但来自少数几个州和城市的数据

sentences.en: are showing that the COVID-19 virus is disproportionately infecting and killing African Americans.
sentences.zh: 显示新冠病毒对非裔美国人的感染和致死率不成比例地高。

sentences.en: In Illinois, for example, African Americans comprise 43% of people who have died from the disease and 28% of positive tests, even though they're only 15% of the state's population.
sentences.zh: 例如在伊利诺伊州，非裔美国人仅占该州总人口的15%，却占了该病死亡人数的43%和阳性检测人数的28%。

sentences.en: Similarly, in Detroit, Milwaukee, North Carolina, Connecticut, South Carolina, African Americans are disproportionately at risk.
sentences.zh: 同样，在底特律、密尔沃基、北卡罗来纳州、康涅狄格州和南卡罗来纳州，非裔美国人面临的风险也高得不成比例。

sentences.en: Why is this so?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: And what can we do to alleviate these skewed proportions as we work together to flatten the curve and beat back this pandemic?
sentences.zh: 在我们共同努力拉平感染曲线并击退这场大流行病的同时，我们能做些什么来缓解这些失衡的比例呢？

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, the flagship podcast of the American Psychological Association.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听美国心理学会的旗舰播客《心理学谈话》。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人金·米尔斯。

sentences.en: Most media reports of these inequities suggest that African Americans are at higher risk than
sentences.zh: 大多数关于这些不平等的媒体报道都认为，非裔美国人面临的风险高于

sentences.en: other populations because of a higher incidence of underlying chronic medical conditions such
sentences.zh: 其他群体，这是因为他们患有糖尿病和高血压等潜在慢性疾病的比例更高，

sentences.en: as diabetes and hypertension, and because African Americans are less likely to have health insurance or a regular health care provider.
sentences.zh: 而且非裔美国人不太可能拥有医疗保险或固定的医疗服务提供者。

sentences.en: While these factors may be true, this analysis overlooks the root causes of the African American health gap, historic and contemporary racism and discrimination.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些因素可能是事实，但这种分析忽略了导致非裔美国人健康差距的根本原因，即历史和当代的种族主义与歧视。

sentences.en: Here to talk about these issues and what psychology can do about them is Dr. Brian Smedley,
sentences.zh: 今天来到节目中探讨这些问题以及心理学能为此做些什么的是布莱恩·斯梅德利博士，

sentences.en: APA's Chief of Psychology and the Public IntereSt.
sentences.zh: 他是美国心理学会心理学与公共利益部门的负责人。

sentences.en: In this post, Dr. Smedley leads APA's efforts to apply the science and practice of psychology to the fundamental problems of human welfare and social justice.
sentences.zh: 在这个职位上，斯梅德利博士领导美国心理学会致力于将心理学的科学与实践应用于人类福利和社会正义的根本问题。

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, Dr. Smedley.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《心理学谈话》，斯梅德利博士。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me, Kim.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我，金。

sentences.en: My first question to you, as we began to see the disparate impact of COVID-19 on African
sentences.zh: 我的第一个问题是，当我们开始看到新冠疫情对非裔美国人产生的影响差异时

sentences.en: Americans in places like Chicago, New Orleans, and the other locations I mentioned a moment ago, were you surprised?
sentences.zh: 对于芝加哥、新奥尔良以及我刚才提到的其他地方的美国人来说，你们感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: Unfortunately, I'm not.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，我并不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Epidemics and pandemics historically have hit our most vulnerable and marginalized populations hardeSt.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，流行病和大流行病对我们最脆弱和最边缘化的群体打击最为沉重。

sentences.en: We know this from past epidemics.
sentences.zh: 我们从过去的流行病中就已得知这一点。

sentences.en: And in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而在美国，

sentences.en: context, of course, African Americans have faced generations of systemic discrimination and racism, as you pointed out.
sentences.zh: 正如你所指出的，非裔美国人几代以来一直面临着系统性的歧视和种族主义。

sentences.en: So the fact that African Americans have higher rates of chronic health conditions to begin with is in itself a reflection of that social and economic inequality.
sentences.zh: 因此，非裔美国人本身就患有更高比例的慢性健康疾病，这本身就是这种社会和经济不平等的反映。

sentences.en: And so pandemics such as COVID-19 are going to spread most rapidly among those populations that are most vulnerable and have been, in fact, marginalized historically.
sentences.zh: 所以，像新冠肺炎这样的大流行病，注定会在那些最脆弱且在历史上一直被边缘化的群体中传播得最快。

sentences.en: So unfortunately, we could have predicted that this would happen.
sentences.zh: 因此不幸的是，我们本可以预见到这种情况会发生。

sentences.en: And as the epidemic continues to spread, we can predict that other populations that have
sentences.zh: 随着疫情持续蔓延，我们可以预见，其他同样

sentences.en: faced historic discrimination and marginalization will also experience higher rates of spread of the virus.
sentences.zh: 面临历史性歧视和边缘化的群体，也会经历更高比例的病毒传播。

sentences.en: Are we seeing some of that already?
sentences.zh: 我们现在是否已经看到了一些迹象？

sentences.en: I've read that some of the rates among the Latino community are also out of proportion.
sentences.zh: 我读到过一些报道，称拉丁裔社区的感染率也高得不成比例。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And there are a number of factors that contribute, of course, to the spread of the virus in these populations.
sentences.zh: 当然，有许多因素导致了病毒在这些群体中的传播。

sentences.en: You look at living conditions where people may not be able to practice physical distancing.
sentences.zh: 看看人们可能无法进行物理距离隔离的居住条件。

sentences.en: You look at the kinds of work that people of color are disproportionately in, sectors where
sentences.zh: 看看有色人种不成比例地从事的工作类型，在这些行业中，

sentences.en: they might be considered essential workers or don't have the economic luxury of being able
sentences.zh: 他们可能被视为必要工作人员，或者没有经济条件让他们能够

sentences.en: to stay home rather than going out and working, housing conditions, conditions in neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 留在家中而不是外出工作，还有住房条件以及社区环境。

sentences.en: All of these factors may contribute to the spread of the virus.
sentences.zh: 所有这些因素都可能导致病毒的传播。

sentences.en: And it's important to note that in many cases, these are environmental conditions that the residents
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，在许多情况下，这些环境条件是当地居民

sentences.en: of those neighborhoods have very little control over, such as the presence of environmental pollutants.
sentences.zh: 几乎无法控制的，比如环境污染物的存在。

sentences.en: There's some new research, for example, suggesting that in neighborhoods with a higher concentration of air pollution, that the COVID-19 virus is spreading more rapidly.
sentences.zh: 例如，一些新的研究表明，在空气污染浓度较高的社区，新冠病毒的传播速度更快。

sentences.en: And you can see how that might be the case, given the fact that respiratory illnesses are more often linked with air pollution and other sources of environmental degradation.
sentences.zh: 考虑到呼吸系统疾病通常与空气污染及其他环境退化因素有关，你就能明白为什么会这样了。

sentences.en: What about immigration status?
sentences.zh: 那么移民身份呢？

sentences.en: How is that playing into the infection rates in those communities?
sentences.zh: 这在这些社区的感染率中起到了什么作用？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so this is a complex issue that, again, complicates our ability to flatten the curve, to contain the spread of the virus.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个复杂的问题，它再次增加了我们平抑疫情曲线、遏制病毒传播的难度。

sentences.en: There are many new arrivals to our country.
sentences.zh: 我国有很多新移民。

sentences.en: Some are legal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 有些是合法移民。

sentences.en: Some are folk who are here without documentation.
sentences.zh: 有些是没有合法证件的人。

sentences.en: Of course, among those without documentation, there's a fear of ICE intervention and detainment, deportation.
sentences.zh: 当然，在这些没有证件的人群中，他们担心会受到美国移民及海关执法局（ICE）的干预、拘留或驱逐。

sentences.en: So you can see how individuals who are here without documentation might be fearful of coming
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看出，那些没有合法证件的人在出现症状时，

sentences.en: forward if they're symptomatic, or they might be fearful of getting relatives tested who might be symptomatic.
sentences.zh: 可能会害怕站出来就医，或者害怕让同样出现症状的亲属去接受检测。

sentences.en: But even among folk who are here legally, among legal immigrants, the fact that the administration
sentences.zh: 但即使是在合法移民中，由于政府

sentences.en: has taken steps to curtail their use of or access to public benefits, such as safety net
sentences.zh: 已经采取措施限制他们使用或获取公共福利（如社会安全网计划），

sentences.en: programs, for fear that that might be detrimental when applying for permanent legal residency, that
sentences.zh: 因为担心这可能会对申请永久合法居留权产生不利影响，这种

sentences.en: kind of fear can also suppress the ability or willingness of folk, even among legal immigrants,
sentences.zh: 恐惧心理也会抑制人们，即便是合法移民，其寻求帮助的能力或意愿。

sentences.en: to access testing or other public health services or public benefits that might be otherwise helpful to them.
sentences.zh: 以获取检测或其他可能对他们有帮助的公共卫生服务或公共福利。

sentences.en: Do you think that the historic mistrust of organized medicine among some black people, especially older black people, is playing a role in this?
sentences.zh: 你认为一些黑人，尤其是年长的黑人，对正规医疗机构的历史性不信任在其中起到了作用吗？

sentences.en: Well, the mistrust issue is a complex one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不信任的问题很复杂。

sentences.en: Certainly, there is mistrust among some segments.
sentences.zh: 当然，在某些群体中确实存在不信任感。

sentences.en: But I think a broader issue is the fact that people of color, African Americans in particular,
sentences.zh: 但我认为一个更广泛的问题是，有色人种，特别是非洲裔美国人，

sentences.en: are very aware of the research showing that they often receive a lower quality of care than
sentences.zh: 非常清楚相关研究显示，他们所获得的医疗服务质量往往低于

sentences.en: white patients, even when they're presenting with the same illnesses, the same kinds of health insurance, and sometimes even in the same health systeMs.
sentences.zh: 白人患者，即使在他们患有相同疾病、拥有相同医疗保险，甚至有时在同一医疗系统内也是如此。

sentences.en: So the fact that there are disparities in health care and the quality of care for these populations may be playing a larger role than the issue of mistrust itself.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些群体在医疗保健和护理质量方面存在差异的事实，可能比不信任问题本身起到了更大的作用。

sentences.en: I think all of these factors, of course, are things that our health care systems need to actively address.
sentences.zh: 我认为所有这些因素，当然，都是我们的医疗保健系统需要积极解决的问题。

sentences.en: And so when we allow this kind of fear to persist, what it does is it increases risk for all of us if some of our communities are left vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们任由这种恐惧持续存在时，如果我们的某些社区处于脆弱状态，这会增加我们所有人的风险。

sentences.en: Is there some impact from basically the reticence of some people to even get tested?
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至不愿去接受检测，这种顾虑是否产生了一定影响？

sentences.en: I mean, I think we know from the HIV epidemic that there are a lot of people who said, I don't even want to know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为我们从艾滋病疫情中了解到，有很多人说，我甚至不想知道结果。

sentences.en: I won't get tested because what can I do about it?
sentences.zh: 我不会去检测，因为知道了又能怎样呢？

sentences.en: Is that playing into it as well?
sentences.zh: 这是否也在其中起作用？

sentences.en: That possibly may be the case.
sentences.zh: 这可能确实是原因之一。

sentences.en: Certainly, we know that in the early days of the HIV epidemic, because it was often a death sentence,
sentences.zh: 当然，我们知道在艾滋病疫情初期，因为它往往被视为死刑判决，

sentences.en: that certainly people felt a loss of control, even if they knew their status.
sentences.zh: 所以人们确实感到失去了控制感，即使他们知道自己的状况。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, it's important, of course, to know one's status, whether we're talking about COVID-19 or HIV.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，了解自己的状况当然很重要，无论是对于新冠肺炎还是艾滋病。

sentences.en: The other challenge, of course, though, with the issue of stigma and testing, is that some populations who may be at heightened risk may not even be offered testing.
sentences.zh: 当然，关于污名化和检测问题的另一个挑战是，一些可能处于高风险的群体甚至可能根本没有机会接受检测。

sentences.en: So the issue of bias and stigma goes both ways.
sentences.zh: 所以偏见和污名化的问题是双向的。

sentences.en: On the one hand, there may be stigmatized populations may fear getting tested.
sentences.zh: 一方面，受污名化的群体可能会害怕去接受检测。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, those health professionals who are charged with determining where these tests are being applied,
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，那些负责决定检测资源分配的医疗专业人员，

sentences.en: because remember, there aren't enough tests at present to address the needs of the population,
sentences.zh: 因为要记住，目前并没有足够的检测手段来满足所有人的需求，

sentences.en: or at least those who might be symptomatic, they are making decisions about who gets testing.
sentences.zh: 或者至少无法满足那些可能有症状的人，他们正在决定谁能获得检测。

sentences.en: And again, we know from a large body of research that, unfortunately, patients of color are less likely to get evidence-based
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我们从大量的研究中得知，不幸的是，有色人种患者获得循证

sentences.en: or recommended interventions, possibly including testing, based on their identity status and stereotypes and biases, even unconscious biases, that health professionals may hold.
sentences.zh: 或推荐干预措施（可能包括检测）的可能性较低，这取决于他们的身份地位、刻板印象和偏见，甚至是医疗专业人员可能持有的无意识偏见。

sentences.en: Some of the messages that are being spread in minority communities and elsewhere, I mean, it's creeping into the media for certain,
sentences.zh: 在少数族裔社区和其他地方传播的一些信息，我的意思是，这些信息确实正在渗透到媒体中，

sentences.en: include that the coronavirus was created in a lab in the United States and it was sent to China, that this was all a plot.
sentences.zh: 包括新冠病毒是在美国的一个实验室制造并被送到中国的，这一切都是一个阴谋。

sentences.en: There is also a president and others who are hyping untested medications.
sentences.zh: 还有总统和其他人正在炒作未经测试的药物。

sentences.en: What's the psychological impact of hearing this kind of information,
sentences.zh: 听到这类信息会产生什么样的心理影响，

sentences.en: and how can people sort out the scientific facts from misapprehensions or even, in some cases, outright falsehoods?
sentences.zh: 人们又该如何从误解甚至在某些情况下是彻头彻尾的谎言中理清科学事实呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're touching on an issue that's critically important in the pandemic response.
sentences.zh: 是的，你提到的这个问题在疫情应对中至关重要。

sentences.en: It's vitally important that everyone have accurate scientific information about what they can do to reduce their risk,
sentences.zh: 让每个人都能获得关于如何降低风险的准确科学信息，这一点至关重要，

sentences.en: what they should do if they're symptomatic, and what they should do to help their families and their communities.
sentences.zh: 包括他们出现症状时应该做什么，以及他们应该如何帮助自己的家庭和社区。

sentences.en: And so, certainly, we know that misinformation is more likely to spread when people are fearful, when people are anxious, and when people are uncertain.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们知道当人们感到恐惧、焦虑和不确定时，错误信息更容易传播。

sentences.en: And that is certainly the psychological state of much of the population during this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 而这无疑是疫情期间大部分民众的心理状态。

sentences.en: So, that's why it's so vitally important that our elected officials and our public health leaders
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是为什么我们的民选官员和公共卫生领导人如此重要，

sentences.en: communicate clearly and in culturally excellent ways to reach all of our populations, providing the best scientific information so that people can trust what they're hearing,
sentences.zh: 他们需要以清晰且符合文化需求的方式进行沟通，以触达我们所有的群体，提供最好的科学信息，让人们能够信任他们所听到的内容，

sentences.en: they can take action to reduce their risk.
sentences.zh: 从而采取行动降低风险。

sentences.en: But when we have the opposite, when we have clear instances of misinformation, when people are not getting the facts, it only contributes more to the fear and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 但当我们面对相反的情况，即出现明确的错误信息，人们无法获得事实真相时，这只会加剧恐惧和焦虑。

sentences.en: And those kinds of psychological states can make it harder to help reduce risk for many of our populations and ultimately flatten the curve.
sentences.zh: 而这些心理状态会使我们更难帮助许多群体降低风险，并最终拉平感染曲线。

sentences.en: So, clearly, the psychological dimensions of the pandemic are absolutely vital to address, just as we do things like physical distancing.
sentences.zh: 因此，显然，解决疫情的心理层面问题与我们采取物理隔离等措施一样，绝对至关重要。

sentences.en: What are some of the possible solutions to these health inequities?
sentences.zh: 针对这些健康不平等问题，有哪些可能的解决方案？

sentences.en: What is APA and psychology asking our governments and the public to do?
sentences.zh: 美国心理学会（APA）和心理学界正在要求政府和公众做些什么？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: There are a number of steps that have to be taken.
sentences.zh: 必须采取一系列措施。

sentences.en: We know that it's essential that public health agencies conduct surveillance, collecting data to understand which populations are at risk.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，公共卫生机构进行监测并收集数据以了解哪些群体处于风险之中是至关重要的。

sentences.en: Where is the virus going?
sentences.zh: 病毒正在向哪里传播？

sentences.en: Where do we need to focus resources to help communities to manage their risk?
sentences.zh: 我们需要在哪里集中资源来帮助社区管理风险？

sentences.en: So, we've called on much more robust, standardized data collection.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们呼吁进行更强有力、更标准化的数据收集。

sentences.en: The federal government has a significant role to play in terms of providing resources
sentences.zh: 联邦政府在提供资源方面发挥着重要作用，

sentences.en: and technical assistance to state and local health agencies who are often on the front lines of testing.
sentences.zh: 并为通常处于检测第一线的州和地方卫生机构提供技术援助。

sentences.en: But then, ultimately, we need to coordinate all of the state and local and federal data collection into one comprehensive database.
sentences.zh: 但最终，我们需要将所有州、地方和联邦的数据收集工作协调到一个综合数据库中。

sentences.en: We only know that African Americans are higher at risk because of the data collection and surveillance work that some states and localities are engaged in.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以知道非裔美国人的风险更高，正是因为一些州和地方正在进行的数据收集和监测工作。

sentences.en: We need all states and localities to have the resources, capacity, and technical know-how to be able to do this.
sentences.zh: 我们需要所有州和地方都具备资源、能力和技术知识来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, over the past several decades, the public health infrastructure has been decimated
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，在过去的几十年里，公共卫生基础设施遭到了破坏，

sentences.en: by funding cuts at all levels, federal, state, and local, leaving us poorly prepared to deal with a pandemic such as that which we're dealing with now.
sentences.zh: 各级（联邦、州和地方）的资金削减，使我们应对当前这种疫情的能力准备不足。

sentences.en: So, what we need is a much more robust effort led by federal support and resources to help collect data.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们需要在联邦支持和资源的引导下，做出更强有力的努力来帮助收集数据。

sentences.en: So, data collection is a first step.
sentences.zh: 所以，数据收集是第一步。

sentences.en: A second thing that we have to do is to ensure that people have access to the services they need.
sentences.zh: 我们要做的第二件事是确保人们能够获得他们所需的服务。

sentences.en: Health care, obviously, is a critically important service, but mental and behavioral health care are critically important as well,
sentences.zh: 医疗保健显然是一项至关重要的服务，但心理和行为健康护理也同样至关重要，

sentences.en: particularly for vulnerable populations that may be at higher risk and face a host of other sources of stress and other kinds of psychosocial stressors.
sentences.zh: 特别是对于那些可能面临更高风险并承受着一系列其他压力源及其他心理社会压力因素的弱势群体而言。

sentences.en: So, addressing the health and mental health needs of communities is critically important as well, and we can do that by doing things like expanding health and safety net prograMs.
sentences.zh: 因此，满足社区的健康和心理健康需求也至关重要，我们可以通过扩大健康和社会安全网项目来做到这一点。

sentences.en: States that have expanded Medicaid, for example, are much better prepared and equipped to handle the crush of coronavirus cases that they're experiencing.
sentences.zh: 例如，扩大了医疗补助计划（Medicaid）的州，在应对他们所经历的新冠病例激增时，准备和装备要好得多。

sentences.en: But beyond that, we have to ultimately address the upstream factors, the root causes of health inequities that we see across racial and ethnic groups,
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，我们最终必须解决上游因素，即我们在不同种族和族裔群体中看到的健康不平等的根源，

sentences.en: across groups with different levels of income and education, across groups who are arriving here from different locations from around the globe.
sentences.zh: 包括不同收入和教育水平的群体，以及从全球各地来到这里的群体。

sentences.en: Addressing those inequities requires understanding the social, economic, and environmental determinants of health.
sentences.zh: 解决这些不平等问题需要了解健康的社会、经济和环境决定因素。

sentences.en: I mentioned earlier that there are some neighborhoods that are experiencing higher rates of air pollution,
sentences.zh: 我之前提到过，有些社区正经历着更高水平的空气污染，

sentences.en: and that there may be, there's some indication that those communities may experience a higher incidence of infection with coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 而且有迹象表明，这些社区的新冠病毒感染率可能更高。

sentences.en: Well, those also happen to be neighborhoods that are disproportionately people of color, disproportionately low income.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这些社区恰好也是有色人种比例过高、低收入比例过高的社区。

sentences.en: So, addressing ultimately the factors that expose some neighborhoods to greater risk,
sentences.zh: 因此，最终要解决的是那些使某些社区面临更大风险的因素，

sentences.en: things like neighborhood poverty concentration, addressing sources of environmental degradation, improving sources of nutrition for these neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 比如社区贫困集中化、解决环境退化源、改善这些社区的营养来源。

sentences.en: Many of them are so-called food deserts, lacking access to healthy food retail, which could help to build the necessary physical capacity to fight off infection.
sentences.zh: 其中许多社区被称为“食物沙漠”，缺乏获得健康食品零售的机会，而这本可以帮助建立抵御感染所需的身体素质。

sentences.en: And addressing other neighborhood amenities like parks and recreational facilities.
sentences.zh: 还要解决公园和娱乐设施等其他社区配套设施的问题。

sentences.en: It's interesting to see the disparity in terms of who is able to get out and exercise during this period of physical distancing and staying at home.
sentences.zh: 观察在物理隔离和居家期间，谁能够外出锻炼，这种差异是很有趣的。

sentences.en: Some neighborhoods enjoy access to parks, recreational facilities, other kinds of amenities that allow them to stay physically active,
sentences.zh: 一些社区享有公园、娱乐设施和其他类型的配套设施，使他们能够保持身体活跃，

sentences.en: while many neighborhoods, particularly those that are characterized by high levels of poverty and disinvestment,
sentences.zh: 而许多社区，特别是那些以高贫困率和缺乏投资为特征的社区，

sentences.en: may lack access to those kinds of resources, which again, help build community capacity to avoid risk for infection.
sentences.zh: 可能缺乏这些资源，而这些资源同样有助于建立社区能力以避免感染风险。

sentences.en: A lot of these situations that you've just described are very entrenched in our society.
sentences.zh: 你刚才描述的许多情况在我们的社会中根深蒂固。

sentences.en: They have existed for decades and people have been complaining about food deserts and disparate pollution levels and so forth.
sentences.zh: 它们已经存在了几十年，人们一直在抱怨食物沙漠、不平等的污染水平等等。

sentences.en: What's different now?
sentences.zh: 现在有什么不同？

sentences.en: I mean, do we really have the willpower to change it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们真的有改变它的意志力吗？

sentences.en: Are you feeling more hopeful that somehow out of this pandemic will come the change that we need?
sentences.zh: 你是否感到更有希望，认为这场疫情最终会带来我们所需要的变革？

sentences.en: I think pandemics and epidemics definitely expose inequities that we all need to be concerned about.
sentences.zh: 我认为大流行病和流行病绝对暴露了我们都需要关注的不平等问题。

sentences.en: Pandemics ultimately know no boundaries, right?
sentences.zh: 大流行病最终是不分国界的，对吧？

sentences.en: They are we are all at risk, whether you no matter what your race or ethnicity, your income, your education level.
sentences.zh: 我们都面临风险，无论你的种族、族裔、收入或教育水平如何。

sentences.en: And so clearly, if some communities face higher risk, then we're going to be much more challenged to be able to contain the pandemic and flatten the curve.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，如果某些社区面临更高的风险，那么我们将面临更大的挑战来控制疫情并拉平曲线。

sentences.en: So I think people are starting to see that persistent social and economic inequality, persistent discrimination,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为人们开始看到，持续的社会和经济不平等、持续的歧视、

sentences.en: persistent racism and other kinds of destructive social hierarchies ultimately impede our ability to manage epidemics and pandemics
sentences.zh: 持续的种族主义和其他破坏性的社会等级制度，最终阻碍了我们管理流行病和大流行病的能力，

sentences.en: and to promote good public health and mental health.
sentences.zh: 也阻碍了我们促进良好的公共卫生和心理健康的能力。

sentences.en: So sadly, as tragic as this pandemic has been, part of what it is signaling to the country is that our fates are deeply intertwined
sentences.zh: 所以可悲的是，尽管这场疫情非常悲惨，但它向全国发出的信号之一是，我们的命运是紧密相连的，

sentences.en: and we ignore the needs of our most vulnerable communities at our own peril.
sentences.zh: 如果我们忽视最弱势群体的需求，我们将自食其果。

sentences.en: How much has xenophobia played a role in what's happening in some of these minority communities?
sentences.zh: 仇外心理在这些少数族裔社区所发生的事情中扮演了多大的角色？

sentences.en: And what are you doing to counteract that?
sentences.zh: 那么，你们正在采取什么措施来抵消这种影响呢？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, again, because of fear, because of uncertainty, because people don't have facts, it tends to engender stereotypes.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，同样是因为恐惧、因为不确定性，也因为人们缺乏事实依据，这往往会助长刻板印象。

sentences.en: It tends to create space for xenophobic attitudes and racist attitudes to creep into the public consciousness.
sentences.zh: 这往往会为排外和种族主义态度渗透进公众意识创造空间。

sentences.en: And it's particularly troubling when leaders and elected officials use irresponsible language that foments xenophobic feelings.
sentences.zh: 而当领导人和民选官员使用不负责任的言论来煽动排外情绪时，情况就尤其令人担忧了。

sentences.en: The APA has called for our leaders to use responsible language to call the virus what it is.
sentences.zh: 美国心理学会（APA）已呼吁我们的领导人使用负责任的语言，以其本名来称呼这种病毒。

sentences.en: It's COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 它叫新冠肺炎（COVID-19）。

sentences.en: There's no need to link it to a specific region of the country, because all that does is it increases risk for people of Asian descent to be attacked,
sentences.zh: 没有必要将其与国内的特定地区挂钩，因为这样做只会增加亚裔群体遭受攻击的风险，

sentences.en: to be bullied with racist and xenophobic attacks, both in public spaces and in virtual spaces.
sentences.zh: 让他们在公共场所和虚拟空间中遭受种族主义和排外主义的欺凌与攻击。

sentences.en: The problem with that, again, is that it divides our communities.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这样做的问题在于它会分裂我们的社区。

sentences.en: It makes it easier to blame an innocent victim rather than blaming the real culprit here, which is the virus itself.
sentences.zh: 这使得人们更容易去指责无辜的受害者，而不是指责真正的罪魁祸首，即病毒本身。

sentences.en: So what we know from psychological research is that communities that have come together, that have found ways to solve their challenges,
sentences.zh: 所以，从心理学研究中我们了解到，那些团结一致、找到了解决自身挑战方法的社区，

sentences.en: communities that have high levels of what we call collective efficacy, are those communities that are going to rebound the quickest from the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 那些具备我们所称的“集体效能”水平较高的社区，正是那些能从疫情中恢复得最快的社区。

sentences.en: It strongly suggests that even though we're physically distancing, it's social cohesion, social coming together that's going to help us solve this problem.
sentences.zh: 这有力地表明，尽管我们正在保持物理距离，但正是社会凝聚力、社会的团结一致，才能帮助我们解决这个问题。

sentences.en: I happen to know that the APA recently sent a letter to the White House asking the federal government to take the lead on requiring states and localities to report race, ethnicity,
sentences.zh: 我恰好知道，美国心理学会最近致信白宫，要求联邦政府带头，要求各州和地方政府报告种族、族裔，

sentences.en: and other demographic characteristics of the people who are infected with the coronavirus, as well as those who die from it.
sentences.zh: 以及其他感染冠状病毒的人员及其死亡人员的人口统计特征。

sentences.en: What's been the response?
sentences.zh: 目前的反应如何？

sentences.en: We've been very pleased with the response.
sentences.zh: 我们对目前的反应感到非常满意。

sentences.en: People understand at all levels, federal, state, and local, that collecting this data is essential to understanding who's been affected and where the virus is going.
sentences.zh: 各级联邦、州和地方政府都明白，收集这些数据对于了解谁受到了影响以及病毒的传播路径至关重要。

sentences.en: So we're very pleased.
sentences.zh: 所以我们感到非常欣慰。

sentences.en: The White House Domestic Policy Council is seeking a meeting.
sentences.zh: 白宫国内政策委员会正在寻求举行会议。

sentences.en: We have elected officials on both sides of the aisle who are looking for solutions.
sentences.zh: 我们有来自两党的民选官员都在寻求解决方案。

sentences.en: And so certainly when it comes to things like data collection, we need to be very concerned about personal privacy and our federal laws protecting the privacy,
sentences.zh: 当然，当涉及到数据收集之类的事情时，我们需要非常关注个人隐私以及我们保护隐私的联邦法律，

sentences.en: the private health records of individuals.
sentences.zh: 即个人的私人健康记录。

sentences.en: But in this instance, when we're facing a pandemic, we need coordinated federal, state, and local action to understand who's being tested, who's being hospitalized,
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，当我们面临大流行时，我们需要协调一致的联邦、州和地方行动，以了解谁在接受检测、谁在住院，

sentences.en: what kinds of treatments are they getting.
sentences.zh: 以及他们正在接受什么样的治疗。

sentences.en: Again, as I mentioned earlier, we have research showing that on average,
sentences.zh: 再次重申，正如我之前提到的，我们的研究表明，平均而言，

sentences.en: patients of color are less likely to get the kinds of medical interventions and services that are the gold standard for medicine.
sentences.zh: 有色人种患者获得作为医学黄金标准的医疗干预和服务的可能性较低。

sentences.en: So unless we're collecting this data, we are not likely to see where there might be disparities that might be dangerous for all of us.
sentences.zh: 因此，除非我们收集这些数据，否则我们很可能无法发现可能对我们所有人构成危险的差异。

sentences.en: So the APA is calling for a much better coordinated federal response.
sentences.zh: 所以，美国心理学会正在呼吁采取协调性更好的联邦应对措施。

sentences.en: We're looking to see if the private sector can get engaged, helping to apply tools like artificial intelligence, again,
sentences.zh: 我们正在寻求私营部门能否参与进来，帮助应用人工智能等工具，再次强调，

sentences.en: to model and understand where this virus is going and spreading going forward.
sentences.zh: 对这种病毒未来的走向和传播进行建模和理解。

sentences.en: So we're certain that there's a short-term response that's necessary in terms of getting this data collected quickly and disseminated,
sentences.zh: 因此，我们确信，在快速收集和传播这些数据方面，有必要采取短期应对措施，

sentences.en: and a longer-term response in terms of understanding how we coordinate the vast array of federal data sources that can give us a more complete picture on how to stop the virus.
sentences.zh: 而在理解如何协调庞大的联邦数据源以提供更完整的抗疫图景方面，则需要长期的应对措施。

sentences.en: Well, Dr. Smedley, thank you so much for joining Speaking of Psychology today.
sentences.zh: 好的，斯梅德利博士，非常感谢您今天参加《心理学谈话》节目。

sentences.en: I think this has been an interesting conversation.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一次有趣的谈话。

sentences.en: I appreciate the work that you're doing to try to flatten the curve and end this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我很感谢您为努力拉平曲线并结束这场大流行所做的工作。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Kim.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，金。

sentences.en: And for our listeners, if you have any comments or ideas that you want to share about our podcast, you can send an email to speakingofpsychology at apa.org.
sentences.zh: 对于我们的听众，如果您对我们的播客有任何想分享的评论或想法，可以发送电子邮件至 speakingofpsychology@apa.org。

sentences.en: That's speakingofpsychology, all one word, at apa.org.
sentences.zh: 地址是 speakingofpsychology，全部拼写在一起，后面接 @apa.org。

sentences.en: You can find previous episodes of Speaking of Psychology on Apple, Stitcher, Spotify, or wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 您可以在 Apple、Stitcher、Spotify 或任何您获取播客的地方找到《心理学谈话》往期节目。

sentences.en: You can also go to our website and download all the episodes at www.speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 您也可以访问我们的网站 www.speakingofpsychology.org 下载所有剧集。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: For the American Psychological Association, I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯，代表美国心理学会。
